explanation: On a 1902 hunting trip, Roosevelt refused to shoot a captured bear. A cartoon of the scene inspired a Brooklyn shopkeeper to sell a stuffed toy as Teddy's bear.

claims.text: The teddy bear is named after US President Theodore 'Teddy' Roosevelt.
The teddy bear is not named after Franklin D. Roosevelt, Abraham Lincoln or Woodrow Wilson.
On a hunting trip in 1902, Theodore Roosevelt refused to shoot a bear that had been captured and tied up for him.
A newspaper cartoon of the incident inspired the Brooklyn shopkeeper Morris Michtom to sell a stuffed bear called Teddy's bear.
